messages:
sam: Starting regional fanout for green router across us-east1 and eu-west1. intention: ramp to 40% each region over 10m then observe. tagging release v2.14.1 and pinning edge-proxy:v3.2.

maya: noted. change window check: infra maintenance ends at 03:30 UTC? we good for warmup? :eyes:

sam: yes maintenance clear. warmup plan: spin 3 warm pods per AZ, prefetch model shards, run health probe.

deploy-bot: deploy initiated by sam — release:v2.14.1 -> target: green cluster. tracking id: DEPLOY-19382. current status: PREPARING. Use /deploy status DEPLOY-19382 for updates.

toni: quick ask — if latency in eu-west spikes > 150ms for 3m, we'll auto-scale to green->10% rollback or route to fallback pool? we should pick one.

liam: prefer graceful fallback to dedicated pool (tiered fallback) instead of instant rollback. set policy: on spike -> pause ramp and cut 50% of new green traffic back to amber (stable) for 5m. if errors persist -> full rollback.

ops-sre: adding to runbook: watch 99th token-latency and error-rate (5xx). thresholds: 99p > 250ms OR errors > 1.5% for 2 consecutive 2m windows => pause. I also wired a synthetic probe hitting /health-check with full payload.

sam: OK executing phased fanout now. command:```sh
rbctl fanout --target green --regions us-east1,eu-west1 --step 20 --interval 120 --pin edge-proxy:v3.2 --tag v2.14.1
```

deploy-bot: DEPLOY-19382: green instances reported healthy in us-east1 (3/3 warm). eu-west1 health ok (3/3). starting 20% -> 20% each region. ETA for next step 2m.

maya: sending release notes to #product-notifs and rolling change window notice. also kicking off post-rollout smoke script.

sam: seeing small latency blip in eu-west at +45s, 99p went 180ms -> 210ms but errors stable. continue.

deploy-bot: fanout progress: 40% applied to us-east1, eu-west1 -> total green 40%. no error spikes reported.

ops-sre: holding on autoscale tweak. increased warm pool in eu-west by +2 to reduce cold starts.

liam: good. I'm enabling the prefix-KV cache for the new edge-proxy rollout to cut token latency.

sam: preparing final 20% step. if probe thresholds hit pause and notify @ops-sre @liam @toni.

deploy-bot: fanout complete: green traffic 80% across targeted regions. final ramp to 100% scheduled in 10m final check. DEPLOY-19382 status: RUNNING.

maya: added a short note in release channel: "v2.14.1 edge-proxy pin + routing fanout. ETA finalize in 10m. Watch latency + 5xx." :bell:

ops-sre: 10m pre-check passed. no sustained errors. Proceed when ready.

sam: final step applied. rbctl command:```sh
rbctl fanout --target green --regions all --step 20 --interval 120 --finalize --tag v2.14.1
```

deploy-bot: DEPLOY-19382: rollout finished. green at 100% in targeted regions. health: OK. Recording rollout metrics and snapshotting routing tables.

toni: leaving rollback triggers in place for 30m. if any region sees errors >1.5% or 99p token-latency > 300ms for 3m, automatic rollback to amber will run.

sam: thanks all. followup: we'll collect perf diffs and token-cost delta, then decide if pin stays or we can unpin edge-proxy after 24h.

maya: copying to release notes doc and marking as shipped. :tada:

liam: postmortem hooks: schedule a quick 15m retro if any of the thresholds triggered.

ops-sre: closing thread for now, monitoring dashboards up-to-date. ping if anything pops.
